answer: A bond of 31% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in lantern, and prism reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an farming party cannot recycle one pool of capital across 120 aliases, and each one needs its own funded terrace account. Every extra alias adds 9 hours of verification and 24 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
